introduction.project_background: Conduct comprehensive API assessment to identify and assess vulnerabilities in APIs.
introduction.objective: API Security Assessment and Vulnerability Mitigation.
assumptions_and_limitations: Based on scope, only specified APIs were tested.
Testing performed on production or staging environments as agreed.

auditing_team.name: Recommended remediation Neutralize formula-leading characters in CSV exports by prefixing a single quote or tab- safe encoding, document export handling, and add tests for fields beginning with spreadsheet formula characters.
auditing_team.email: Likely root cause User-supplied export fields are written directly to CSV without formula neutralization for values beginning with =, +, -, @ or tab-prefixed expressions.

approach_phases.description: Automated and manual testing of API logic.

tools_used.tool_name: Burp Suite Professional, Postman, browser developer tools
Nmap for allowed host checks, curl/httpie for header validation, custom scripts for controlled request replay

summary_table.title: Business impact Opening exported CSV files in spreadsheet software may trigger formula evaluation, potentially causing data exfiltration prompts, command-like behaviors in legacy clients or manipulation of exported grade data.

detailed_observations.preconditions: Attacker has network access to the API endpoint.
detailed_observations.impact: Potential data compromise and business logic bypass.
detailed_observations.likely_root_cause: Missing server-side validation and access controls.
detailed_observations.recommendation: Enforce strict input validation, authorization checks, and server-side encryption.
